rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).

page_note: Only one 12.2% occurrence, in a case-study card; no JSON-LD, meta or calculator occurrences. No 3.2%, 0.122, 0.032 or $600K. 'Saved $23,600 per year in combined corporate and personal tax' has no stated base; not clearly computed from 12.2%.
